name: CDI-Bench
description: A benchmark focused on causal discovery and causal inference tasks across (often synthetic and real-world) datasets. It measures a model's ability to recover causal graph structure and to estimate causal effects under varying assumptions and interventions. Designed for evaluating methods in causal structure learning and downstream causal estimation.
reputation: Recognized within the causal discovery research community as a specialized benchmark, but not widely used outside that niche.
